title: Shallow Card
description: A searchable index card built by engine/cards.mjs from a corpus record (see schemas/record.schema.json). Carries shapes only -- symbol names, dependency names, short claim strings -- never file bodies or secret values.

provenanceKnown.description: Whether provenance was verified locally rather than assumed (false for remote-only repos)

dedupVerified.description: Whether duplicate collapse was actually verified against a remote key rather than assumed (false when no remote was configured)

skippedSecretFiles.description: Total files that contributed nothing to the card: skippedByFilename + skippedByContent

skippedByFilename.description: Files skipped by name alone (.env-shaped), never opened

skippedByContent.description: Files opened, then dropped whole because a line inside looked secret-shaped

scanTruncated.description: True if a cost cap (file-count or file-size) cut the code scan short -- the card's deps/symbols/entrypoints are then a partial, not a complete, picture of the repo. False for shallow-remote cards (no scan ran at all, a different condition from a scan that ran and was cut short).

truncatedBy.description: Which cap(s) tripped, when scanTruncated is true. maxFileBytes also covers an oversized README.md/CLAUDE.md, the same size guard applied to a different file. maxSymbols means more distinct symbols were found than the card can carry -- symbols/entrypoints/deps are a partial picture even when no file-level cap also tripped.
